rules: Every threat references exactly one existing asset.
Every threat includes at least one compromised cybersecurity property.
Every threat has at least one attack path.
Every attack path score equals ET+SE+KoIC+WoO+Eq.
Every threat aggregate attack feasibility equals the highest feasibility of its linked attack paths.
Every risk value is recomputed from impact and aggregate attack feasibility.
Every treatment is recomputed from the adopted treatment policy.
Every REDUCE threat is covered by at least one cybersecurity goal.
Every RETAIN threat is covered by at least one cybersecurity claim.
